% Pattern: number/class-section. revtex4-1 with the AIP society, as the
% options aip,jmp, prints \thesection in Arabic, so a theorem numbered within
% the section prints 2.1. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want thm-1 statement/theorem 1.1
% want thm-2 statement/theorem 2.1
\documentclass[aip,jmp,
preprint]{revtex4-1}
\newtheorem{Thm}{Theorem}[section]
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{Thm} Every compact space is bounded. \end{Thm}
\section{Two}
\begin{Thm} Every finite space is bounded. \end{Thm}
\end{document}
